item.title: Release Channel 1.100.58
item.dc:creator: steeven
item.description:
Where to download:

Brave Desktop:

  • Download Brave Browser
  • Brave Github repository

Linux

  • Linux installation instructions

Full Release Notes

  • Added support for on-device WebSpeech API for English (being rolled out in phases using Griffin starting at 25%). (#56487)
  • [Security] Updated various sync “datatype” values to “EncryptableUserTypes”. (#61788)
  • Updated AI Chat models. (#59884)
  • Updated UI polish for various icons, colors, and spacing. (#60161)
  • Updated split view UI for stacked mode. (#59845)
  • Fixed issue where “.onion” domains could be leaked as reported on HackerOne by newfunction. (#59801)
  • Fixed crash which occurred when the ability to set Brave as default browser was disabled via Admin policy on Linux. (#60038)
  • Fixed an issue where using “Add Tab to New Split View” on a tab in a container did not open the split view tab in the same container. (#59951)
  • Fixed an issue where https://play.xbox.com and other sites that require viewport size request headers would fail to load. (#61705)
  • Upgraded Chromium to 158.0.8127.42. (#61954) (Changelog for 158.0.8127.42)

Origin Release Notes

  • [Security] Updated various sync “datatype” values to “EncryptableUserTypes”. (#61788)
  • Updated UI polish for various icons, colors, and spacing. (#60161)
  • Updated split view UI for stacked mode. (#59845)
  • Fixed crash which occurred when the ability to set Brave as default browser was disabled via Admin policy on Linux. (#60038)
  • Fixed an issue where using “Add Tab to New Split View” on a tab in a container did not open the split view tab in the same container. (#59951)
  • Fixed an issue where https://play.xbox.com and other sites that require viewport size request headers would fail to load. (#61705)
  • Upgraded Chromium to 158.0.8127.42. (#61954) (Changelog for 158.0.8127.42)
